descriptionHtml:
The IEEE MTT-S Student Branch Chapter of the University of Peradeniya successfully hosted the SAT CAP 2022 webinar session on the 26th of April 2022 using the Zoom online platform  with the participation of Prof Aruna Gunawardana, Senior Advisor of  IEEE MTT-S Student Branch Chapter of University of Peradeniya.

 

The session was conducted by Eng Tharindu Dayarathne from Arthur C Clerke Institute. This webinar is the first session of the SAT CAP webinar and workshop. During the webinar Eng Tharindu Dayarathne clearly outlined The KITSUNE satellite construction, technologies employed, and antenna concepts. A vivid explanation was given by Dr Tharindu Dayaratne on QHF antennas and its structure In order to conduct the SATCAP workshop on QHF antennas. What should and what not to do while building a QHF antenna? This was clearly clarified by this experienced professional on that day.Finally he outlined how to capture signals of kitsune satellites using a home built QHF antenna.

 

The webinar's purpose was fully addressed during the session, which was highly effective in getting everyone ready for the physical workshop that followed. Through this conversation and the Q&A that followed, the participants were able to learn more about QHF antennas and receive more insights and explanations
